description: How often a flight has been late over the last 30 days, or the last days days (up to 400, the record's reach). Returns n (arrivals graded against a published arrival schedule) with its on-time and late counts, ungraded_arrivals (landings with no published schedule to grade), cancelled and diverted counts, operations (n + cancelled + diverted, the base for shares), unconfirmed legs left out, the window (shorter when the record limit cut it), the late rule with its minute threshold, and a link to the flight page on gaduin.com.

days.description: History window in days (1-400); defaults to 30. window reports the span actually covered.

number.description: Flight number: airline IATA or ICAO code plus number, e.g. AA1.
